primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters Improves visual quality, 10-second clarity, trust, conversion, engagement, retention, performance, or monetization without exposing founder-only methodology.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Clarity (dimensionless score), Trust (probability mass), Engagement (time units).

primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when information density exceeds the user's working memory capacity, leading to catastrophic loss of trust and conversion drop-off.

primitives.name: Epistemic Boundary Layer
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Public/Private Boundary Public sees reveal-less explanations, confidence-safe language, and last-verified/source cues where appropriate.
primitives.assumptions: The public interface must decouple the certainty of the output from the opacity of the internal generative model.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the boundary leaks high-fidelity methodological details, allowing adversarial actors to reverse-engineer the core competitive advantage.

layer2.mapping: Maps to the GSE state-transition veto mechanism, preventing unauthorized transitions into 'methodology exposure' states.

primitives.name: Compliance Constraint Set
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Legal / Compliance Boundary No live sportsbook/casino affiliate links, no guaranteed wins, no irresponsible gambling copy, no minors targeting, no legal claims without approval.
primitives.assumptions: The operational space is strictly bounded by hard regulatory constraints that cannot be violated under any stochastic realization.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur if automated copy generation bypasses the constraint set, resulting in immediate legal termination and platform de-listing.

layer2.mapping: Directly isomorphic to the GSI legal/compliance filter, acting as a hard mask on the output distribution of all generated content.
layer2.telemetry: Legal risk flag count, affiliate link scanner hits.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This framework inherits from information theory's rate-distortion principles, adapted for human-computer interaction. Historically, early web design lacked formal budgets, leading to chaotic user experiences. The introduction of responsive design provided geometric constraints, but modern AI-driven interfaces require epistemic constraints to manage trust. Our primitives extend Shannon's channel capacity theorem into the domain of cognitive load and legal compliance, creating a unified field theory for sovereign digital products.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the user as a rational agent seeking maximum signal-to-noise ratio under time pressure, while simultaneously modeling the regulator as an adversarial observer probing for violations. The system must anticipate the user's desire for clarity without feeding the regulator's suspicion of manipulation. This dual-agent modeling forces the interface to adopt a stance of 'grounded transparency,' where confidence is expressed through source cues rather than absolute claims, effectively managing the expectations of both the consumer and the overseer.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical anti-collinearity condition exists between the cognitive budget and the epistemic boundary. If the drive for '10-second clarity' pushes the system to expose raw probabilistic outputs (e.g., exact win probabilities), it breaches the epistemic boundary. The cross-layer veto mechanism monitors the correlation between visual density and method leakage; if they rise together, the system triggers a rollback, prioritizing secrecy over marginal gains in conversion. This ensures that the pursuit of performance never compromises the foundational sovereignty of the intellectual property.
